Not quite—the quantities are **equal**, so the answer is **C**.

Since $x\neq 0$, you can divide by $x$:

$$\frac{4x^3}{2x}=\frac{4}{2}x^{3-1}=2x^2.$$

That matches Quantity B exactly. When simplifying a quotient with the same nonzero base, divide the coefficients and subtract the exponents.
